question: If x² + 1over x² = 98, then the value of x + 1over x is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If x² + 1/x² = k, then x + 1/x = √(k + 2)

Here, the given value of k is 98.

⇒ x + 1/x = √(98 + 2)

⇒ x + 1/x = √100 = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

x² + 1/x² = 98

**Formula Used:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

**Calculations:**

⇒ (x + 1/x)² = x² + 1/x² + 2 × x × (1/x)

⇒ (x + 1/x)² = x² + 1/x² + 2

Substitute the given value of x² + 1/x² = 98:

⇒ (x + 1/x)² = 98 + 2

⇒ (x + 1/x)² = 100

Taking the square root on both sides:

⇒ x + 1/x = √100

⇒ x + 1/x = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Square of Difference

If x − 1/x = k, then x² + 1/x² = k² + 2. Conversely, x − 1/x = √(x² + 1/x² − 2).

Cubes of Sum

If x + 1/x = k, then x³ + 1/x³ = k³ − 3k.

Cubes of Difference

If x − 1/x = k, then x³ − 1/x³ = k³ + 3k.

Higher Powers

To find x⁴ + 1/x⁴, square the value of x² + 1/x² and subtract 2.
